description: Visit the Mega Monster Mash and meet an unusual pet, the Ukrainian Levkoy; it is a medium-sized cat breed known for its hairless or peach-fuzz body, wrinkled skin, folded ears and angular, dog-like profile.

title: Board Stories
description: From Pipeline to Jaws, Brazil to El Salvador, Mike Latronic chases the world's best surf; slo-mo barrels, top-level free surfing, and monster big waves, shot with Brent Bielmann.

title: Flippin Uce
description: With city inspectors giving the green light, it's full steam ahead; crews install drywall while electricians prep new lighting and outlets; concrete is poured for walkways, a ramp and fencing; the project's vision is coming to life.

title: Hawaiian Xtreme Sports TV
description: It's all about giant winter surf on Oahu's and Maui's North Shores; as some of the largest surf in over a decade rolls in, we witness as daredevils from around the globe push the limits.

title: Ocean Paddler TV
description: Travel to the Garden Isle for the OC1 races of the Kauai World Challenge. And travel to Maui for the sailing canoe Waa Kiakahi crossing to Molokai.

title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
description:
S04 E82
Jennifer Zelko-Schlueter, Manager of Government and Community Relations at Hawaii Electric Light Company, not only shares what they've been doing in our community, but her delicious Tofu Stir Fry recipe as well!

title: Hawaii Skin Diver
description: Hawaii Skin Divers are on the hunt for fresh salmon and halibut in Homer, Alaska.

title: Sports People Hawaii
description: Gary Shim overcame injuries to be one of the top powerlifters in the state. The Hawaii Harlequins rugby team has been in Hawaii for over 50 years. Tips on running correctly to avoid injuries.

title: Board Stories
description: Highlights from the Surfer Awards show. European riders get a dose of magic in the Mediterranean. The artist Hula makes a special tribute mural for Andy Irons. A magical day of tube riding at Pipeline.

title: Ultimate Japan
description: Ride in style on a ferry to beautiful Sado Island. Then in Sado, the group has a unique kind of lunch and experiences plant dyeing. They end the day with a delicious Japanese-style dinner.

title: Here in Hawaii
description: Uplifting stories about people keeping the aloha spirit alive.
